source_refs.note: Limitations in Dimensional Analysis: a main subheading of 1.7 Dimensions of physical quantities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 15-17.

blocks.text: The dimensional method cannot identify where an equation is wrong. Even if an equation is proved correct, we can only say the equation might be correct, for the reason that the method does not provide a check on any numerical factor or constant. That can only be determined by experiments or plotting some suitable graph between the variables.
